quotes.quote: To know God’s mighty works, to understand His wisdom, majesty, and power; to appreciate, to some extent, the marvelous workings of His laws—surely all this must be a form of worship that is pleasing and acceptable to the Most High, for whom ignorance cannot be more pleasing than knowledge.

quotes.author: Copérnico
quotes.quote: Every light has its shadow, and every shadow has a morning to follow.

quotes.author: Copérnico
quotes.quote: The universe was created for us by a supremely good and orderly Creator.

quotes.author: Copérnico
quotes.quote: Trismegistus calls it a “visible God”; Electra by Sophocles, “that which beholds all things.” And so the sun, as if resting on a royal throne, rules over the family of stars that revolve around it.

quotes.author: Copérnico
quotes.quote: Nations are not ruined by a single act of violence, but rather gradually and almost imperceptibly by the depreciation of their currency in circulation, due to its excessive supply.

quotes.author: Copérnico
quotes.quote: The Earth's immense mass is actually insignificant compared to the size of the heavens.

quotes.author: Copérnico
quotes.quote: For what could be more beautiful than the heavens, which contain all things beautiful?

quotes.author: Copérnico
quotes.quote: I am aware that a philosopher's ideas are not subject to the judgment of ordinary people, because his endeavor is to seek the truth in all things, to the extent that human reason allows, God willing.

quotes.author: Copérnico
quotes.quote: In so many and such significant ways, then, the planets bear witness to the Earth's movement.

quotes.author: Copérnico
quotes.quote: The disdain my opinion drew because of its novelty and unconventionality almost led me to abandon the work I had undertaken entirely.

quotes.author: Copérnico
quotes.quote: Astronomy is written for astronomers. To them, my work will also seem—unless I am mistaken—to make some contribution.

quotes.author: Copérnico
quotes.quote: In the midst of it all, the sun remains.

quotes.author: Copérnico
quotes.quote: It is an astronomer's duty to piece together the history of celestial movements through careful and expert study.

quotes.author: Copérnico
quotes.quote: For a traveler heading north from any location, that pole of the daily rotation gradually rises higher, while the opposite pole drops by an equal amount.

quotes.author: Copérnico
quotes.quote: True laws cannot be arrived at through the use of reason; and based on these assumptions, motions can be correctly calculated, both for the future and for the past.

quotes.author: Copérnico
quotes.quote: The apparent retrograde and direct motion of the planets is not due to their own motion, but to the Earth's motion.

quotes.author: Isaac Newton
quotes.quote: For every action, there is always an equal reaction.

quotes.author: Isaac Newton
quotes.quote: Gravity explains the movements of the planets, but it cannot explain who sets the planets in motion.

quotes.author: Isaac Newton
quotes.quote: I can calculate the motion of celestial bodies, but not the madness of people.

quotes.author: Isaac Newton
quotes.quote: You have to make the rules, not follow them.

quotes.author: Isaac Newton
quotes.quote: Nature delights in simplicity. And nature is not foolish.

quotes.author: Isaac Newton
quotes.quote: It is the weight, not the number of experiments, that should be taken into account.

quotes.author: Isaac Newton
quotes.quote: Live your life as an exclamation rather than an explanation.

quotes.author: Isaac Newton
quotes.quote: Any force exerted on a body is directly proportional to the acceleration it will experience.

quotes.author: Isaac Newton
quotes.quote: Nature is truly consistent and at ease with itself.

quotes.author: Isaac Newton
quotes.quote: Unity in diversity, and diversity in unity, is the supreme law of the universe.

quotes.author: Isaac Newton
quotes.quote: For me, there has never been a greater source of earthly honor than the recognition associated with advances in science.

quotes.author: Isaac Newton
quotes.quote: Someone whom no one likes is generally not liked by anyone.

quotes.author: Isaac Newton
quotes.quote: There is no philosophy more sublime than that known as Holy Scripture.

quotes.author: Isaac Newton
quotes.quote: Those who set out to seek the philosopher's stone according to its own rules will be bound to a strict and devout life.

quotes.author: Isaac Newton
quotes.quote: The more time and effort one spends worshiping false gods, the less time one has to think about the true God.

quotes.author: Isaac Newton
quotes.quote: There are more reliable indications of authenticity in the Bible than in any secular history.

quotes.author: Isaac Newton
quotes.quote: If others thought as hard as I did, they would get similar results.

quotes.author: Isaac Newton
quotes.quote: Hypotheses should not be considered in experimental philosophy.

quotes.author: Isaac Newton
quotes.quote: My discoveries have been made possible because they were the answer to my prayers.

quotes.author: Isaac Newton
quotes.quote: God is everywhere, the thoughts in our minds are somewhere, and all bodies occupy space.

quotes.author: Isaac Newton
quotes.quote: It is impossible to exist without being connected to space in some way.

quotes.author: Isaac Newton
quotes.quote: God gave the prophecies of the Old Testament, not to satisfy people's curiosity, but so that they could later be interpreted in light of how they had been fulfilled.

quotes.author: Isaac Newton
quotes.quote: When the two forces join together, their efficiency doubles.

quotes.author: Isaac Newton
quotes.quote: I take out my telescope and look at space—what lies millions of kilometers away.

quotes.author: Isaac Newton
quotes.quote: Physics, be very careful with metaphysics.

quotes.author: Isaac Newton
quotes.quote: God created everything according to His rules, including numbers, weights, and measures in all things.

quotes.author: Isaac Newton
quotes.quote: The best way to understand this is by using good examples.

quotes.author: Isaac Newton
quotes.quote: No older person likes math.

quotes.author: Isaac Newton
quotes.quote: Atheism is so senseless and hostile to humanity that it has never had many adherents.

quotes.author: Isaac Newton
quotes.quote: I will not confuse conjecture with certainty.

quotes.author: Gregor Mendel
quotes.quote: A seed is the foundation of life and contains within itself all the potential for an organism's growth and development.

quotes.author: Gregor Mendel
quotes.quote: Inheritance is the transmission of traits from one generation to the next, and it is a fundamental part of evolution.

quotes.author: Gregor Mendel
quotes.quote: The study of genetics allows us to understand how traits are passed down and combined within a population.

quotes.author: Gregor Mendel
quotes.quote: The study of hereditary traits helps us understand the variety and diversity of life.

quotes.author: Gregor Mendel
quotes.quote: It is important to remember that not all traits are hereditary; environmental factors also shape an organism.

quotes.author: Gregor Mendel
quotes.quote: Genetics teaches us that there is no “correct” or “better” version of a trait; all genotypes and phenotypes are valid and have their place in nature.

quotes.author: Gregor Mendel
quotes.quote: The discovery of the laws of inheritance has allowed us to breed species by selecting the best traits to produce stronger and more suitable individuals.

quotes.author: Gregor Mendel
quotes.quote: Crossbreeding between individuals reveals the presence of recessive and dominant genes.

quotes.author: Gregor Mendel
quotes.quote: Mendelian genetics teaches us that inheritance is based on the segregation and recombination of alleles.

quotes.author: Gregor Mendel
quotes.quote: Hereditary traits can be influenced by multiple genes and factors.

quotes.author: Gregor Mendel
quotes.quote: Genetics shows us how small changes at the genetic level can result in major variations in an organism's traits.

quotes.author: Gregor Mendel
quotes.quote: Genetics provides a powerful tool for medicine, allowing us to understand and treat genetic diseases.

quotes.author: Gregor Mendel
quotes.quote: Living beings are not isolated entities; rather, they are interconnected through heredity and evolution.

quotes.author: Gregor Mendel
quotes.quote: Genetic studies help us understand and conserve biological diversity.

quotes.author: Gregor Mendel
quotes.quote: Genetics shows us that all living things share a common ancestor.

quotes.author: Gregor Mendel
quotes.quote: Our understanding of genetics shows us that appearances can be deceiving and that external traits do not always reflect a person's true genetic makeup.

quotes.author: Gregor Mendel
quotes.quote: Genetics teaches us that genetic variability is essential for the survival and adaptation of species.

quotes.author: Gregor Mendel
quotes.quote: Genetics is not limited to living organisms; it also applies to other complex systems, such as the economy and social networks.

quotes.author: Gregor Mendel
quotes.quote: Genetics shows us that we are responsible for our own actions, since our choices can influence the genetic legacy we pass on to future generations.

quotes.author: Gregor Mendel
quotes.quote: Genetics reminds us that we are part of an ongoing evolutionary process and that our purpose in life is to contribute to the growth and development of future generations.

quotes.author: Gregor Mendel
quotes.quote: Genetics teaches us to respect and value diversity, since every individual is unique in terms of their genetic makeup.

quotes.author: Gregor Mendel
quotes.quote: Mendel's laws are a testament to the beauty and elegance of nature.

quotes.author: Gregor Mendel
quotes.quote: Genetics shows us that there is no distinction between the living and the non-living, since all systems are connected through heredity and evolution.

quotes.author: Gregor Mendel
quotes.quote: Genetics is a powerful tool for understanding and conserving biodiversity.

quotes.author: Gregor Mendel
quotes.quote: Genetics helps us understand how changes in genes can lead to diseases and how we can prevent or treat them.

quotes.author: Gregor Mendel
quotes.quote: Genetics reminds us that we are not the masters of nature, but an integral part of it.

quotes.author: Gregor Mendel
quotes.quote: Genetics reveals to us the immense complexity and beauty of life in all its forms.

quotes.author: Gregor Mendel
quotes.quote: Genetics helps us understand and appreciate the interconnectedness of all living things.

quotes.author: Gregor Mendel
quotes.quote: An understanding of genetics allows us to make informed and ethical decisions on issues such as genetic modification and the use of technology.

quotes.author: Gregor Mendel
quotes.quote: Genetics shows us that the future of life on Earth depends on our ability to value and protect genetic diversity.

quotes.author: François de La Rochefoucauld
quotes.quote: It is the same with true love as it is with ghosts; everyone talks about them, but very few have actually seen them.

quotes.author: François de La Rochefoucauld
quotes.quote: The easiest way to be taken in is to think you’re smarter than everyone else.

quotes.author: François de La Rochefoucauld
quotes.quote: Solemnity is a trick the body uses to conceal the mind’s flaws.

quotes.author: François de La Rochefoucauld
quotes.quote: ‘Fool’ is the name we usually give to those who do not think like us.

quotes.author: François de La Rochefoucauld
quotes.quote: If we judge love by most of its effects, it resembles hatred more than friendship.

quotes.author: François de La Rochefoucauld
quotes.quote: No disguise can hide love for long where it exists, nor feign it where it does not.

quotes.author: François de La Rochefoucauld
quotes.quote: We are never as happy or as unhappy as we think we are.

quotes.author: François de La Rochefoucauld
quotes.quote: We put more effort into making others believe we are happy than into actually trying to be happy.

quotes.author: François de La Rochefoucauld
quotes.quote: Temperance is the worship of the body that prevents one from gorging oneself on food.

quotes.author: François de La Rochefoucauld
quotes.quote: Sometimes we think we hate flattery, but what we actually hate is the way it is done.

quotes.author: François de La Rochefoucauld
quotes.quote: Jealousy thrives on doubt, and the truth either dispels it or fuels it.

quotes.author: François de La Rochefoucauld
quotes.quote: Silence is the safest course of action for someone who lacks self-confidence.

quotes.author: François de La Rochefoucauld
quotes.quote: It is more shameful to mistrust one’s friends than to be deceived by them.

quotes.author: François de La Rochefoucauld
quotes.quote: Everyone complains about their memory, but nobody complains about their intelligence.

quotes.author: François de La Rochefoucauld
quotes.quote: Old people like to give good advice, to console themselves for not being able to set bad examples.

quotes.author: François de La Rochefoucauld
quotes.quote: To take revenge for an offence is to stoop to the level of one’s enemies; to forgive it is to rise above them.

quotes.author: François de La Rochefoucauld
quotes.quote: Repentance is not so much regret for the wrong we have done as fear of the harm that may befall us as a result.

quotes.author: François de La Rochefoucauld
quotes.quote: Sometimes a fool has talent, but never good judgement.

quotes.author: François de La Rochefoucauld
quotes.quote: Every stage of life is new to us; no matter how old we are, we are still plagued by inexperience.

quotes.author: François de La Rochefoucauld
quotes.quote: Temperament often determines the courage of men and the virtue of women.

quotes.author: François de La Rochefoucauld
quotes.quote: Philosophy easily triumphs over past and future misfortunes, but present misfortunes triumph over philosophy.

quotes.author: François de La Rochefoucauld
quotes.quote: The duration of our passions depends just as little on us as the length of our lives.

quotes.author: François de La Rochefoucauld
quotes.quote: Passions often give rise to others that are their opposites: greed sometimes leads to extravagance, and extravagance to greed; we are often steadfast because we are weak, and bold because we are cowardly.

quotes.author: François de La Rochefoucauld
quotes.quote: Flattery is a kind of bad money, for which our vanity provides the currency.

quotes.author: François de La Rochefoucauld
quotes.quote: Some falsehoods so closely resemble the truth that it would be a mistake not to be taken in by them.

quotes.author: François de La Rochefoucauld
quotes.quote: We have no patience with other people’s vanity because it is offensive to our own vanity.

quotes.author: François de La Rochefoucauld
quotes.quote: To be successful, we must do everything we can to appear successful.

quotes.author: François de La Rochefoucauld
quotes.quote: Eating is a necessity, but eating sensibly is an art.

quotes.author: François de La Rochefoucauld
quotes.quote: Moderation is a virtue invented to curb the ambition of great men and to console the mediocre for their meagre merits.

quotes.author: François de La Rochefoucauld
quotes.quote: The reason why lovers never get bored of being together is that they spend their time constantly talking about themselves.
